Since we do not have the actual RFP text, the best move is to revise the generic response to commit to serving amended, request-specific responses and add concrete timing/search/log language while preserving objections. drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

We disagree that Defendant has waived any objections, but to avoid unnecessary motion practice Defendant is serving amended responses that clarify the scope of its search, whether responsive documents are being withheld on asserted objections, and the timing for production and any privilege log. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents located after a reasonable search on a rolling basis, with substantial completion targeted for 30 days from service of the amended responses, subject to any issues arising from volume, ESI collection, or third-party custodians. Any privilege log will be served within 30 days after substantial completion of production, absent agreement or Court order otherwise.

Please let us know promptly if you contend any particular amended response remains deficient so the parties can confer before involving the Court.

Regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production as set forth below. These responses are made after reasonable inquiry based on information presently known and available to Defendant, and are subject to supplementation in accordance with the applicable rules.
edits.name: Preliminary Statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to the Requests to the extent they seek information or documents protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, common-interest privilege, or any other applicable privilege or protection; seek documents outside Defendant's possession, custody, or control; impose obligations beyond those required by the applicable rules; are overbroad, unduly burdensome, not proportional to the needs of the case, or seek information not relevant to any claim or defense. These General Objections are incorporated into each response only to the extent specifically stated in the response to that Request. Defendant will state in each request-specific response whether responsive documents are being withheld on the basis of the objections asserted for that Request.
edits.name: General Objections

edits.text: 2. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES AND PRODUCTION. Defendant will serve amended, request-by-request responses. For each Request, Defendant will state whether responsive, non-privileged documents within Defendant's possession, custody, or control will be produced, whether documents are being withheld based on any asserted objection, and the general scope of the search Defendant is undertaking. Subject to the objections stated in the request-specific responses and without waiving them, Defendant will conduct a reasonable search of custodial and non-custodial sources likely to contain responsive documents, including reasonably accessible electronic files and email repositories of relevant custodians identified through Defendant's investigation. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents located through that search on a rolling basis, with substantial completion targeted for 30 days after service of the amended responses, subject to modification for good cause, including volume, ESI collection or processing issues, or information learned during the search.
edits.name: Request-Specific Responses and Production

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, common-interest privilege, or another applicable protection, Defendant will provide a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules and any governing order of the Court. Defendant will serve any privilege log within 30 days after substantial completion of its document production, unless the parties agree or the Court orders otherwise. Defendant need not log privileged communications or work product created after commencement of this action unless required by rule, order, or agreement.
edits.name: Privilege Log

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves all rights and objections, including the right to amend, supplement, or correct these responses as appropriate. Nothing in these responses constitutes an admission that any requested document exists, is relevant, is proportional to the needs of the case, is admissible, or is within Defendant's possession, custody, or control.
edits.name: Reservation
